title: cairn's scratch-HOME proofs build their child env through home_env
intention: Every scratch-HOME child cairn/devices/cairn's proofs start gets its home through home_env, so on every platform it finds its home in the scratch and never reaches the live ~/.cairn.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienyoga9i (Windows) at cairn 96aa5dac7: cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.scratch_home_bypass(<repo>) names 2 site(s) in cairn/devices/cairn: cairn/devices/cairn/proofs/test_start_stop_restart_cycle_the_system.py:96 _cairn; cairn/devices/cairn/proofs/test_the_cycle_verbs_refuse_what_they_do_not_know.py:82 _cairn. Each builds a child env with HOME set to a scratch by hand, so on Windows, where Path.home() reads USERPROFILE (d95796cdfb9b), the child resolves the LIVE ~/.cairn, and none gets home_env's CAIRN_BUS_ scrub (3301915df481).
traces_to: d95796cdfb9b (a scratch HOME is the child's home on Windows too); 3301915df481; Law 3.
how: D1 each named site builds its env with home_env(home, **extra), keeping its own scrub on the result.

clauses.claim: scratch_home_bypass(<repo>) names no site under cairn/devices/cairn
each named proof file is green and a Windows run of it writes nothing under the live ~/.cairn

decisions.text: D1: at cairn/devices/cairn/proofs/test_start_stop_restart_cycle_the_system.py:96 _cairn; cairn/devices/cairn/proofs/test_the_cycle_verbs_refuse_what_they_do_not_know.py:82 _cairn, the env is home_env(home, **the site's other keys); a site's own key scrub applies to home_env's result.

measured.what: scratch_home_bypass over the repo, sites under cairn/devices/cairn
measured.how: py -3 -c scratch.scratch_home_bypass(Path('.')) in cairn at 96aa5dac7 on akienyoga9i
